about: Hindi drafted by machine in waves 3 and 4 (keys added since wave 2, and wave 2 keys whose Hindi was redrafted), waiting for a native reviewer (spec section 10). tests/text.test.ts checks that every English key added since tests/baselines/text-keys-w2.json, and since tests/baselines/text-keys-w3.json for wave 4, is listed here. `engine` names the engine files whose own Hindi (marked HINDI_REVIEW) the same reviewer reads. Once a native reviewer has checked them, move the baselines forward and empty these lists.
